body:
Edit Image 1, the existing clear 5 ml cylindrical glass bottle cutout. Image 2 is ONLY a glass-material reference; do not borrow its geometry, proportions, thread layout, camera angle, framing or background. Return ONE bare uncapped glass bottle as a separate transparent PNG with real alpha.

This is a precision material-and-detail enhancement of an engineering-registered configurator layer. Preserve the exact outline and crop of Image 1: total height-to-width ratio, neck diameter, shoulder height and roundness, two upper helical thread turns and lower neck retaining ring at their original positions, opening/rim shape, body diameter, rounded heel and base thickness, vertical centerline. Maintain its eye-level straight-on camera and almost invisible top opening. Do not thicken the glass or expand the neck. Do not add rings, alter the cap seating area, shorten the body or change the bottom.

Make it look like a real premium clear glass product photographed in a controlled studio: realistic round cylindrical light roll-off, soft broad highlights with narrower polished specular reflections, subtle real refraction around threads and shoulder, clean clear interior with no rectangular paper cutout or opaque white panel. Keep the useful reflection pattern of Image 1 while refining clarity and removing lumpy or melted-looking glare artifacts. Avoid excessive heavy black outlines or blown-out white edges. Keep the glass transparent-looking, genuinely three-dimensional and color-neutral. No tint, frost, liquid, cap, roller, pump, tube, labels, logos, text, props, floor, baked shadow or background.

Clean edge alpha precisely around the genuine silhouette. Remove isolated stray white pixels above the rim and beneath the base; preserve the actual thin glass rim. No new solid background, fuzzy halo or missing glass edges.

Use highest native resolution/detail available; request a 1828 x 3442 image if supported, exactly the original canvas aspect ratio of 914:1721. Preserve framing fractions and object proportions. Geometry is locked; enhance photographic material and fine detail only.
sprayer:
Precision restoration edit of the existing product cutout, Image 1. Output ONE separate fine-mist sprayer head only, on genuine transparent alpha, same crop, composition, proportions and camera angle as Image 1. Image 2 is a material and lighting reference ONLY for the satin matte champagne-gold metal. It is NOT a shape reference and must not appear in the output.

Keep every existing physical feature from Image 1: three stacked cylindrical diameters, their exact relative heights and widths, step transitions, actuator rim, small round pale grey nozzle insert in the same position and size, the nozzle's tiny dark central hole, straight bottom seating edge. No new parts, no tube, no bottle, no overcap, no text, no surface or shadow. Preserve existing front-facing nearly eye-level angle and narrow curved top. Preserve the overall original 525:976 canvas ratio and approximately 6 pixel edge margin scaled proportionally. Do not make head wider, taller, more bulbous or more conical.

Improve ONLY resolution and realistic photographic material: fine satin anodized gold, coherent soft studio reflections like Image 2, finely resolved realistic metal grain, smooth natural cylindrical highlight roll-off. Clean the existing colored fringe artifacts and irregular alpha edge flecks, keeping all real details. Do not invent wear, scratches, mottled dark spots, huge pores, seams, seams around nozzle, labels or extra holes. Crisp clean edges with anti-aliased alpha, no glowing outlines. High-end product macro photograph, not illustration or plastic.

Use the highest native detail available, ideally at least 1050 x 1952 pixels. Transparent PNG. Geometry and connection point fidelity are essential.
overcap:
Edit the reference product cutout only. This is a resolution-and-material-fidelity restoration of one existing matte-gold metal perfume sprayer overcap. Preserve EXACT existing silhouette, length-to-width ratio, straight vertical sides, shallow curved top edge, nearly straight bottom edge, front-facing eye-level camera, placement, and existing small transparent margin. The referenced cap's visible dimensions are 202 wide by 384 high; preserve that ratio precisely. No change in physical design, color identity, perspective, height, taper or framing. Produce one single cap as a separate transparent PNG layer, no bottle, no nozzle, no tube, no props, no text, no floor, no background, no cast shadow. Keep actual transparent alpha around it.

Improve only the photographic finish and fine edge definition: high-end studio product macro photograph, satin matte champagne-gold anodized metal, subtle realistic fine surface grain, continuous cylindrical highlight roll-off following the existing light direction, controlled soft reflections and smooth gradations. No harsh fake chrome, no extra seams, no rings, no bevel at bottom, no grain clumps or noise. Recover clean fine edges without white/black halos. Keep the bottom flat so it can sit accurately on a configurator baseline.

Request the highest native output detail available, ideally 4 times the source dimensions (856 by 1584 pixels) while retaining the same framing fractions and original aspect ratio. This is an engineering-registered asset: geometric faithfulness is more important than artistic reinterpretation.
